findings: Pinned NNS_G2dGetUnpackedPaletteData finds PLTT and calls NNS_G2dUnpackNCL; that function adjusts pRawData only, does not modify szByte. Struct order fmt, bExtendedPlt, szByte, pointer makes serialized szByte offset 32 in normal NCLR. PCMP lookup is separate.

Pinned JASC has 256 entries; packer uses -bitdepth 4 and writer default padding. Source-derived expected uncompressed shared NCLR payload size 512, total file 552; exact built artifact not retrieved or SDK executed. With full payload at PC offsets 64 or 192 the end offsets 576/704 exceed 512. 96-byte three-bank transfer would fit at both addresses, but no production change authorized.

PC source sets main BG bank B 128KiB, sub BG C 128KiB, OBJ E 64KiB, sub OBJ I 16KiB, texture A and texture palette F/G. Extended BG/OBJ palettes disabled. Main mode 0 uses BG0 3D and BG1/2/3 existing UI. A bitmap layer or extended OBJ palettes would require remapping and lifecycle changes.

Existing PC 3D path initialized and PokemonSpriteManager allocated. Texture space is not established free; 4bpp textures are a promising alternative only if preview coexistence, priorities, geometry, transparency and bank allocation are verified.

Native scroll displacement (21+2)*8 = 184px over 30 updates; R19 composite simulation used a host 168px displacement and seven steps, not exact native timing. Native icon anchor x=112+offset+24*column and y=40+24*row; no native cell pivot equivalence claimed.
